context: French online recruitment and training platform (Télégramme group).
summary: Rotated between the Sales Analysis and Web Analysis teams, on real commercial questions: SQL, Salesforce, BigQuery, Looker Studio.

highlights.title: Sales forecasts
highlights.text: Analysed what drives the forecasts sales reps enter in Salesforce and correlated quotes with opportunity win rates, then turned the findings into recommendations for the sales team.

highlights.title: Web data you can trust
highlights.text: Checked Piano Analytics data against server logs, fixed the filters and rebuilt the Looker Studio dashboards that track conversion and visits.
